requiredFindings.title: The proposed vocabulary additions are internal aliases, not missing public codes
requiredFindings.finding: All four names in section 2.3 occur in public-detail-registry.v1.json.internalAliases, not its public records. aliasRule explicitly prohibits them in public DomainDetailCode. Grammar and crossing map to PROJECT.EXPLICIT_PATH_INVALID; mismatch maps to PROJECT.DISCOVERY_INVENTORY_MISMATCH; too-many-units maps to PROJECT.WORKSPACE_UNIT_LIMIT. Those public targets already exist in the product vocabulary. Adding the four internal names through B-S10 would violate the selected registry rather than materialize it. Section 2.1 also incorrectly calls these names registered public detail codes.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Remove the four public enum additions and the claimed vocabulary gap. Specify the internal-to-public normalization at the host boundary, preserving the reference internal decisions and existing public targets. Update B2-c0 scope and sequence accordingly; test each internal refusal against its registered public route.

requiredFindings.title: The current wrapper and product output must implement the selected V3 contract
requiredFindings.finding: Section 2.1 specifies UnitDiscoveryV2 output, while section 1 only projects the four historical boundary fields into the old model. B-S1 requires UnitDiscoveryV3 with PrunedTreeV3 and UnitBoundariesV2.memberRepositories; its U-8 passage also checks that each non-boundary nested vcs-tree parent is an admitted member. The selected B2-a rule can already emit opensip-custody-state, which the historical V2 output cannot admit even before B3-b adds members. Merely accepting V3 input does not implement these selected output and join obligations.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Specify V3 output admission/projection in both wrapper and product, retain memberRepositories, and preserve the selected SX-1 and U-8 member-consistency rules without implementing B3-b readers. Keep historical V1/V2 replay separate. Add current cases for an empty-member V3 record with a root .opensip anchor, carrying admitted members, and rejecting a nested vcs-tree anchor whose parent is absent from memberRepositories.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The historical model already executes the (path, reason) subset test and carries admitted pruned rows; only its quoted docstring still says must equal. Describe this as stale commentary, not a new algorithm change. Its archived copy also lacks the adjacent foundation/schema/capability files its imports expect; the wrapper should pin and supply the complete selected loading closure while preserving model bytes.

The separate extends law review should make resolution candidate order and package-name/subpath grammar explicit, and select a lawful carrier for unresolvedChoices: current UnitDiscoveryV3 is closed and has no such field. Any added carrier needs an explicit successor route. The proposed data-only bounded resolver and deferred custody are sound directions, not acceptance of an unpublished r8 law or an assertion of complete TypeScript resolver compatibility.
